tasks.title: Drive-backup installer: idempotent marker-guarded pre-push shim writer (render_shim + install + main)
acceptance_criteria: tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py is a NEW single-file, stdlib-only module.
DEFAULT_REPOS == ['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2'] and a SENTINEL marker constant is defined.
render_shim(janusmask_root) returns a '#!/usr/bin/env bash' shim bounded by SENTINEL, embedding the ABSOLUTE janusmask_root, 'python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner', and an unconditional 'exit 0'.
render_shim(..., chained_hook=...) emits a shim that runs the saved original hook with the same stdin/arguments before the backup step.
install(repo_roots, *, fs, janusmask_root, dry_run=False) returns list[InstallResult] and routes each repo's <repo>/.git/hooks/pre-push through the injected fs seam.

No hook -> action 'created'; SENTINEL-managed shim -> action 'updated' (idempotent, never duplicated); foreign hook -> moved to pre-push.pre-janusmask and action 'chained'; dry_run=True -> action suffixed ':dry' with no writes.
Written hook file is marked executable (mode 0o755) via the fs seam.
main(argv=None, *, fs=None) is a CLI shim (--dry-run, optional repo overrides) defaulting fs to a real filesystem adapter and returning 0 on success.

spec.objective: Build a NEW single-file, whole-file, stdlib-only module tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py that idempotently installs a thin, marker-guarded pre-push shim into BOTH repos' .git/hooks/pre-push (JanusMaskJR and NobleGreedv2). The shim execs 'python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner' and always exits 0 for the backup step, preserving any pre-existing non-managed pre-push hook by chaining to it. IMPL-only against the pre-committed RED oracle.
functional_requirements: DEFAULT_REPOS == ['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2'] and a SENTINEL marker constant is defined at module scope.

render_shim(janusmask_root) returns a '#!/usr/bin/env bash' shim bounded by the SENTINEL marker, embedding the ABSOLUTE janusmask_root, 'python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner', and an unconditional 'exit 0' for the backup step.

render_shim(janusmask_root, chained_hook=...) emits a shim that first runs the saved original hook with the SAME stdin and arguments before the drive-backup step (the backup step never affects the exit code).
install writes the shim when no hook exists (action 'created') and marks the written file executable (mode 0o755) via the injected fs seam.
install rewrites in place when a SENTINEL-managed shim already exists (action 'updated', idempotent — the sentinel is never duplicated).

install moves a foreign non-managed hook to pre-push.pre-janusmask and writes a shim that chains to it (action 'chained'); dry_run=True computes the action/target without writing (action suffixed ':dry').
spec.interfaces: tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py: SENTINEL (str marker, e.g. '# >>> janusmask-drive-backup >>>'); DEFAULT_REPOS = ['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2']; render_shim(janusmask_root, *, chained_hook=None) -> str; InstallResult dataclass with fields (repo, hook_path, action, ok); install(repo_roots=DEFAULT_REPOS, *, fs, janusmask_root, dry_run=False) -> list[InstallResult]; main(argv=None, *, fs=None) -> int. The fs seam abstracts exists/read/write/move/chmod so all tested branches run against a fake filesystem.
edge_cases: Re-running install on an already-managed (SENTINEL) shim is idempotent: action 'updated' and the sentinel marker is never duplicated in the rewritten file.
A pre-existing FOREIGN (non-managed) pre-push hook is preserved by moving it to pre-push.pre-janusmask and chaining to it (action 'chained'); the original content is never destroyed.
dry_run=True for any branch computes the action/target via the fs seam without performing any write or chmod (action suffixed ':dry').
non_goals: Live integration — actually writing .git/hooks/pre-push in either repo — is OUT OF SCOPE here; deferred to the user-run install step. The created/updated/chained/dry branches are exercised against an injected fake fs seam only.
No execution of git, push, or the hook itself; no archive/upload/credential logic; no rclone config or login (user-setup doc).
No edits to any existing tracked file in either repo — the only runtime write is .git/hooks/pre-push (untracked git infrastructure). No edits to any _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE file.
No third-party imports (stdlib only). Does NOT author its own oracle — tests/drive_backup/test_install_hooks.py is the hand-authored RED precondition and is authoritative if a pinned name differs.
spec.implementation_notes: Embed janusmask_root as an ABSOLUTE path so the hook installed in NobleGreedv2 still locates the JanusMask module. The shim reads pushed refs from stdin into a temp var; if chained_hook is set, run the saved original hook with the same stdin/arguments first (preserving ITS exit code as the gate), then cd to janusmask_root and pipe stdin into 'python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner "$@"' and 'exit 0' unconditionally. Route every filesystem operation through the injected fs seam (exists/read/write/move/chmod) so tests run against a fake fs. main() defaults fs to a real filesystem adapter at runtime. Treat tests/drive_backup/test_install_hooks.py (8 tests) as authoritative for pinned names.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: A fake fs seam (in-memory) exposing exists/read/write/move/chmod over <repo>/.git/hooks/pre-push and pre-push.pre-janusmask; fixtures for: empty hooks dir (created), a SENTINEL-managed shim (updated/idempotent), and a foreign non-managed hook (chained). An absolute janusmask_root string.

token_budget_ratio.note: New stdlib-only single-file module with a small surface; the bulk of effort is the 6-requirement, branch-heavy oracle (created/updated/chained/dry, idempotency, foreign-hook preservation, executable bit) so test tokens exceed 1.5x impl.
